exposure: prior delivery mode (vaginal delivery, combined vaginal and cesarean delivery)
cohort: The study included 824 singleton pregnant Korean women.
finding: Approximately 40% of Korean pregnant women experience prenatal UI, with prior delivery mode and advanced pregnancy trimester being significant risk factors, while alcohol consumption before pregnancy was a protective factor.
mod_finding: Prior delivery mode, specifically vaginal delivery and combined vaginal and cesarean delivery, were identified as significant risk factors for urinary incontinence.
